results.title: Lesson done!
results.mastered: Amazing! You have got this goal.

results.explainedYes: You explained the balance rule. Great!
results.explainedNo: Next time, try to say what happens to both sides.

tips.M1: Whatever you do to one side, do to the other side too.
tips.M2: The number outside the brackets multiplies everything inside.
tips.M3: Watch the signs when you move negative numbers.
tips.M4: Undo the adding or taking away first. Then divide.
tips.M5: = means both sides balance. It does not mean "the answer is".
